name: uganda-business-directory
description: Shop with an AI assistant that searches available marketplace listings in Uganda and compares options. Find local businesses and list your own in the Muyiribi directory.

defaultPrompt: Help me find and compare a product in Uganda. I can share my budget and location.
interface.longDescription: Search available Ugandan marketplace listings, compare prices and item details with your AI assistant, and follow original links to sellers. You can also find Ugandan businesses in Muyiribi's directory or get a link to list your own business for free. Purchases and paid business plans are handled outside the plugin.
interface.shortDescription: Find products and compare options in Uganda
